'''Galron''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and was discovered to be a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] prodigy during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. However, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in defense of [[Gorinth Brig|Cave 52]].
